caseno: Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 432 of 1997
lawyer:
Md Fazlul Karim, Senior Advocate, instructed by Md Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-Record ----- For the Petitioner. 
Sharifuddin Chaklader, Advocate-on-Record ----- For Respondent No.1. Respondent Nos. 2-15-Not represented.
parties:
Enjaheruddin Mia alias Md Enjaheruddin Mia ------ Petitioner
vs.
Mohammad Hossain and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment:
Mohammad Abdur Rouf J : The plaintiff- petitioner along with his brother respondent No. 15 Md Tota Mia on 29-3-86 instituted Title Suit No. 65 of 1986 initially for declaration of their title to 5.58 acres of land which was subsequently raised by  way of amendment of the plaint to 9.41 acres by incorporating another 12 plots therein. The plaintiff further amended the prayer portion of the plaint on 25-9-88 for a further declaration that the registered deed of gift, dated 27-4-70 claimed to have been executed by his uncle Haji Abdullah in favour of defendant Nos. 1-3 is forged, illegal, collusive and not binding upon them and that the suit land has been wrongly recorded in the SA Khatian to the extent of 8 annas share in the name of their said uncle Haji Abdullah. Their case, in Short, is that their father late Yasin Sheikh acquired the suit properties by different pattas and registered deeds and he died leaving behind two sons and three daughters namely. Maina Bibi (predecessor of defendant Nos. 6-13), Meherunessa (defendant No. 4) and Saleha Khatun (defendant No. 5). Since after the death 0f their father they have been possessing the suit land by bargaders for more than 12 years and thereby they have acquired title to the suit land by adverse possession also. During SA operation 8 annas interest of the suit land was wrongly recorded in the name of their uncle Haji Abdullah who on several occasions promised to rectify the record but unfortunately he could not do so as he was killed by the miscreants during the war of liberation of Bangladesh in 1971. Defendant No.1 upon taking advantage of such wrong recording in the SA Khatian and with a view to grabbing the property 0f the disputed jote including the suit land had fraudulently created the deed of gift on 27-4-70 corresponding to 13 Baishakh 1377 BS beyond the knowledge and consent of said Haji Abdullah by forging the thumb impression of Haji Abdullah and to make the said deed of gift believable to others as genuine one incorporated the names of Abdullah's wife, Fuzan Nessa (defendant No.3) and Abdullah's adopted son Abdur Rahman defendant No.2 along with he himself as the donee. It is asserted in the plaint that defendants Nos. 1-3 have no right, title and possession in the suit land. 

 2. Defendant No. 3 and her son-in-law defendant No. 1. who is also a brother's son of Haji Abdullah, contested the suit by filing a joint written statement contending, inter alia, that Yasin Seikh and his brother Haji Abdullah had jointly acquired the suit property out of their joint fund and they had been jointly possessing the same, accordingly it has been correctly recorded in the relevant SA Khatian. They denied the alleged deed of gift (Ext. ka) dater 27-4-70 as. forged and fabricated document According to them, the said deed of gift is a genuine document to the knowledge of the plaintiffs and that on the basis of the said deed plaintiff No. 2 purchased on 27-4-84 some land from defendant No 2 admitting the document itself. Moreover, one Nuruzzaman, son-in-law of plaintiff No.1, has also purchased some land of the said deed of gift from one Emdadul Huq, who along with Sikder Nizan Hossain had purchased the said land on 7-6-86 from defendant No. 1 and his wife defendant No.3 ka Kulsum Bibi out of the land of the said deed of gift. According to the contesting defendants, the suit as if framed is not maintainable.
